dependency_edges.handoff: The static relation graphs supply initial loyalty, intimacy, hierarchy and assignment context.
The loyalty/intimacy state and transition matrix supply assignment-aware updates.
Updated assignments and states define the monthly dynamic HCN and churn inputs.
Churn and vacancies supply staffing and structural terms for productivity and cost.
Total cost becomes the fitness objective for the restricted genetic assignment.
Baseline assignment and event traces supply the budget comparator.
Baseline cost traces supply the matched churn/recruitment scenario comparison.
Scenario and middle-level vacancy results supply the conditional HR-health reading.
The HR-health and cost limits motivate local parameter analysis and conceptual extensions.
